definitions: To quickly and often temporarily assemble or construct something, especially using available materials.
To prepare or set up something, often in a makeshift or improvised way.
examples: They rigged up a shelter with a tarp and some branches.
He rigged up a pulley system to lift the heavy box.
We rigged up a temporary stage for the performance.
pastTenses: rigged up (past simple), rigged up (past perfect)
